nodes.label: ref-extractor Subagent
nodes.rationale: One-subagent-per-PMID extraction judgment (study-type classification, PICO+ normalization) that a deterministic script cannot perform; scripts only validate/commit its JSON output.

nodes.label: ref-synthesizer Subagent
nodes.rationale: N retrieved evidence candidates -> one grounded answer; PLAN.md names exactly two subagents (ref-extractor, ref-synthesizer) and no others are invented even where a task (e.g. citation checking) doesn't perfectly fit either.

nodes.label: RoB 2 Risk-of-Bias Checklist
nodes.rationale: 5-domain RCT risk-of-bias tool; most domains legitimately resolve to insufficient_information because the phase-4 claim schema captures PICO+outcome data, not methodological-quality signals like randomization concealment or blinding -- an honest limitation, not a module shortfall.

nodes.label: Newcastle-Ottawa Scale
nodes.rationale: 3 star-rated categories (selection, comparability, outcome/exposure) for cohort/case-control studies; only partially assessable from claim-schema fields.

nodes.label: AMSTAR-2 Checklist
nodes.rationale: A representative subset of AMSTAR-2's 16 items (not all) applied to meta-analyses via regex signal-matching on evidence_span text.

nodes.label: GRADE Certainty Rating
nodes.rationale: Cross-paper (set-level) certainty rating, downgraded from an RCT/non-RCT baseline by risk-of-bias, inconsistency, imprecision, and indirectness factors; publication bias is always not_assessed for a curated single-library snapshot; this rating is NOT per-PMID so it has no corrections.json review home, unlike per-paper appraisal domains.

nodes.label: Freeze/Refresh Manifest Contract
nodes.rationale: A saved selector-scoped artifact (export batch, comparison table, brief, appraisal review) never silently changes membership underneath its conclusions: re-running with the same batch/key label and no --refresh reuses the frozen resolution; --refresh re-resolves and reports added/removed/changed items against the prior freeze. Explicitly shared across export.py, compare.py, brief.py, and appraise.py's run_review, each cross-referencing the others in their docstrings.

nodes.label: studies.jsonl (study grouping records)
nodes.rationale: Grouping PMIDs into a study is never automatic (not from shared authors or dataset) -- a human/agent must assert it with confidence + evidence, since correlated papers are not thereby the same investigation.

nodes.label: datasets.jsonl (dataset identity records)
nodes.rationale: Dataset reuse is a separate relationship from study grouping: two papers reusing the same dataset are not thereby the same study.

nodes.label: One-paper vs multi-paper: uniform code path over resolution["pmids"]
nodes.rationale: build_candidates() and run_summarize() operate uniformly over resolution["pmids"] regardless of length so a one-paper set degrades to a single-paper summary through the same code path rather than a special-cased branch.
nodes.norm_label: one-paper vs multi-paper: uniform code path over resolution["pmids"]

nodes.label: ref-synthesizer subagent
nodes.rationale: Reused unchanged from agents/ref-synthesizer.md because its contract ('N retrieved evidence candidates -> one grounded answer') is already generic enough to fit summarize's fixed-instruction narrative task, following the precedent /ref:check-citations set in phase 7 for judgment tasks PLAN.md doesn't name a dedicated agent for.

nodes.label: corrections.json overlay record
nodes.rationale: Six target types (claim, concept_mapping, person_identity, grant_link, author_contribution, appraisal) share one corrections.json record shape per paper for audit symmetry across all review decisions.

nodes.label: grant_link review never folds award_number into approved_aliases
nodes.rationale: Normalization is funder-specific and MUST NOT collapse distinct awards without a reviewed rule; review_grant_link records the link but never calls grant.py's add_alias itself -- folding requires an explicit separate step so distinct award numbers stay distinct unless someone deliberately says otherwise.
nodes.norm_label: grant_link review never folds award_number into approved_aliases

nodes.label: author_contribution flags require explicit evidence, never inferred from position
nodes.rationale: Shared-first, shared-senior, and corresponding authorship are independent flags requiring explicit contribution/correspondence evidence; review_author_contribution refuses without a non-empty evidence_statement, with no default and no inference from last author position.
nodes.norm_label: author_contribution flags require explicit evidence, never inferred from position

nodes.label: Vision description caching keyed by (figure hash, model, prompt)
nodes.rationale: Vision descriptions are selective (requested during promotion or for a question) and cached per figure by hash+model+prompt so identical requests never re-invoke the vision model; the script itself never calls a vision model -- it only manages the cache and figure metadata, leaving actual image interpretation to the calling multimodal agent.
nodes.norm_label: vision description caching keyed by (figure hash, model, prompt)

nodes.label: Vision output labeled model_interpretation, separate from reported results
nodes.rationale: D17: vision descriptions are stored as a sibling `vision` list on the figure entry, never merged into `caption`, and explicitly kind: model_interpretation so a figure description is never mistaken for an author-reported finding.
nodes.norm_label: vision output labeled model_interpretation, separate from reported results

nodes.label: Extraction tiers
nodes.rationale: Promotion only goes up; having full text is a separate fact from tier so acquisition never silently inflates or deflates extraction confidence.

nodes.label: Relations & edges
nodes.rationale: potential_conflict is the only auto-proposed edge type; contradicts requires explicit human review with rationale so disagreements are never silently escalated.

nodes.label: Corrections overlay lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Corrections are appended, never edited in place, and flip to pending_review when underlying evidence changes, so human judgment is preserved as an auditable overlay rather than mutating raw extraction.

nodes.label: Studies, datasets, methods
nodes.rationale: Kept as three separate registries because a shared dataset does not prove two papers report the same study; only explicit create-study groups papers.

nodes.label: Identifier contract
nodes.rationale: Three identifier classes (slugs, citekeys, opaque IDs) keep user-facing names collision-refused while machine IDs stay unambiguous; citekeys are the one exception that gets a suffix so manuscripts never break.

nodes.label: Selector grammar
nodes.rationale: One shared selector grammar resolves to a frozen PMID set copied into every artifact manifest, so a saved comparison or brief never silently changes membership on rerun.

nodes.label: Claim v2 (phase 12)
nodes.rationale: Cited claims stay searchable pointers but never count as evidence, so only a paper's own results support graph edges.

nodes.label: Ontology (phase 13)
nodes.rationale: Auto-apply is restricted to exact alias or MeSH-ID reuse; everything else becomes a reviewed proposal to prevent silent concept merges.

nodes.label: Evidence profile (phase 14)
nodes.rationale: Reports components, an independence range and a band rather than a single 0-100 score, since a single number would falsely imply precision the underlying evidence doesn't support.

nodes.label: Paper directory anatomy
nodes.rationale: Immutable raw snapshots, versioned derived records, and user-owned files are kept in separate zones so regeneration can never overwrite raw evidence or your own annotations.

nodes.label: Papers handoff (asymmetric export)
nodes.rationale: Outbound is files-only and inbound is reads-only because Papers' live database's actions_queue is a sync queue that writes could corrupt; highlights have no outbound path since they're anchored to Papers' own file copy.

nodes.label: Ingest & commit (figure 2)
nodes.rationale: A per-PMID lock serializes writes to one paper while a short-lived library lock only guards citekey allocation, so one paper's failure or slow write never blocks another paper's ingest.

nodes.label: Full-text acquisition (figure 3)
nodes.rationale: fetch.py tries sources in a fixed priority ladder (JATS, Unpaywall, publisher HTML, plain text, abstract-only) and stops at the first applicable rung, so acquisition never silently mixes source quality.

nodes.label: Extraction fan-out (figure 4)
nodes.rationale: One ref-extractor subagent per PMID runs in parallel and commits independently, so one paper's malformed claim never blocks or corrupts another paper's extraction.

nodes.label: Annotations Never Substitute Original Content

nodes.label: Swanson ABC Traversal (/ref:hypothesize)
nodes.rationale: Chains with identical PMID sets on both hops are excluded, but partial overlap counts as independent since full separation is too strict. Zero PubMed hits is not novelty.

nodes.label: Library-Scoped Results Principle

nodes.label: Typed concept relations (supports/extends/replicates/potential_conflict/contradicts)
nodes.rationale: The automatic path is deliberately narrow: only opposite directions under fully matching context become potential_conflict, and nothing becomes contradicts without a human rationale, because a false conflict misleads every downstream answer.

nodes.label: Corrections overlay lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Six target types share one corrections.json overlay shape so raw extraction is never rewritten; person_identity review delegates to person.py rather than reimplementing identity matching, and author_contribution flags refuse without an explicit evidence statement because seniority/correspondence must never be inferred from author position.

nodes.label: Files-are-authority ownership & recovery model
nodes.rationale: SQLite and okf/ are disposable projections; versions are written to a staging directory, validated, then current.json is swapped atomically, so a crash mid-commit never leaves anything half-indexed and the catalog can always be deleted and rebuilt.

nodes.label: Selective, cached figure-vision description

nodes.label: Normalized claim schema (PICO + effect fields)
nodes.rationale: Undeterminable fields are the literal string 'unknown' - never omitted, never guessed.

nodes.label: Evidence tier (abstract | full, D4)
nodes.rationale: Missing full text is not a blocker; abstract-tier extraction is allowed and labelled.

nodes.label: Claim locator + evidence_span quote
nodes.rationale: Direct quote lets a human sanity-check normalization; never fabricate a page number.

nodes.label: Stateless extraction (caller owns persistence)
nodes.rationale: Subagent has no atomic-write/locking/ID allocation; calling command validates schema, assigns stable claim IDs, commits atomically.

nodes.label: Full-text fetch priority ladder
nodes.rationale: PMC JATS -> PubMed MCP plain text -> Unpaywall -> publisher HTML -> abstract-only; legal/available sources only.

nodes.label: Separation of add.py and fetch.py
nodes.rationale: Wrapper is orchestration only; keeps 'create metadata record' separate from 'acquire full text'.

nodes.label: Intake classification (kind + duplicate status)
nodes.rationale: Local deterministic resolver (no network) replaces hand type-dispatch; flags duplicate_in_batch / already_imported.

nodes.label: Attach runs before fetch
nodes.rationale: Each commits a new current version; later JATS is higher fidelity than PDF-converted text, while the PDF stays under raw/<sha256>/source.pdf.

nodes.label: No paywall bypass
nodes.rationale: Publisher page access is not permission to bypass paywalls; fetch follows the legal source ladder.

nodes.label: Frozen brief evidence snapshot (D9 explicit refresh)
nodes.rationale: No scheduled monitoring; refresh reports added/withdrawn evidence rather than silently overwriting; user edits survive unless evidence changed (then stale).
nodes.norm_label: frozen brief evidence snapshot (d9 explicit refresh)

nodes.label: Assertion verdicts (supported/overstated/conflicting/insufficient/unavailable)
nodes.rationale: Never rewrites the user's paragraph; assertion_text must be an exact substring; coverage caveat always relayed.

nodes.label: Inline judgment instead of a subagent
nodes.rationale: PLAN.md §3 names only ref-extractor and ref-synthesizer, neither fits verifying existing text.
nodes.norm_label: inline judgment instead of a subagent

nodes.label: One-way Papers.app file handoff (D28)
nodes.rationale: Never writes the live Papers DB or drives the app; foreign paths reported as conflicts, never overwritten.

nodes.label: Project templates (--template, next_steps)
nodes.rationale: Stamps a proven command sequence; never invents scope text or research questions.

nodes.label: Per-project membership record (relevance, priority, reading state, §3b)
nodes.norm_label: per-project membership record (relevance, priority, reading state, §3b)

nodes.label: Default --limit 20 with full run saved first
nodes.rationale: Prevents accidental large ingests while keeping the search reproducible.
nodes.norm_label: default --limit 20 with full run saved first

nodes.label: PICO to PubMed Boolean query translation
nodes.rationale: MeSH + [tiab] synonyms, [dp]/[pt]/[au] filters; --broad favours sensitivity, --specific precision; no fake last-author field.
nodes.norm_label: pico to pubmed boolean query translation

nodes.label: Immutable saved query run (D15, queries/<slug>/query.yaml)
nodes.rationale: A later update re-runs the stored expression rather than re-deriving from the original question.

nodes.label: Set-level GRADE certainty (grade.json)
nodes.rationale: Judgment about the whole set, so persisted in the review artifact, not per-PMID corrections.

nodes.label: Refusal on wholly abstract-tier sets
nodes.rationale: RoB2/NOS/AMSTAR-2/GRADE need full-text detail.

nodes.label: Triage files (triage.json, metadata batches, decisions.jsonl, pending.json)
nodes.rationale: decisions.jsonl is append-only (newest per PMID wins); query.yaml is never modified.
nodes.norm_label: triage files (triage.json, metadata batches, decisions.jsonl, pending.json)

nodes.label: triage apply (pending full-text fetch)
nodes.rationale: Only final results clear pending; failed PMIDs stay pending so a later apply retries.

nodes.label: Explicit manual re-run, append-only runs (D9, §5c)
nodes.rationale: Never scheduled; prior runs never mutated; scope-changing refinements belong in a new slug to keep run history comparable.

nodes.label: Config file ~/.config/ref-manager/config.json
nodes.rationale: Single source of the active library_root so no command needs --repo; optional unpaywall_email and papers_export_dir are hand-added and lost on init --force.

nodes.label: PubMed MCP tools (get_article_metadata, get_full_text_article, search_articles, find_related_articles)
nodes.norm_label: pubmed mcp tools (get_article_metadata, get_full_text_article, search_articles, find_related_articles)

nodes.label: ref-extractor subagent
nodes.rationale: One Agent-tool call per PMID, launched in one message so they run concurrently; extract.py only validates returned JSON.

nodes.label: ref-synthesizer subagent
nodes.rationale: One invocation per question over the whole candidate set, never once per paper; answers checked by validate_citations.py.

nodes.label: /ref:init
nodes.rationale: User picks the library location; the plugin never hardcodes one. Refuses to overwrite config without --force.

nodes.label: /ref:add
nodes.rationale: Core ingest path; PMID is identity, deduplicated, papers without abstracts still added as extraction_tier unavailable; nothing fabricated.

nodes.label: /ref:attach
nodes.rationale: Refuses a PDF unless pdftotext identity check matches it to the paper (or --force).

nodes.label: /ref:query-pubmed and saved queries
nodes.rationale: Runs append to queries/<slug>/query.yaml and are never mutated, so selectors can pin a specific run.

nodes.label: Per-project / per-paper / library-wide state ownership
nodes.rationale: Reading status and screening are per project so one paper can be included in one project and to_screen in another; notes/corrections are per paper; study groupings are library-wide. Acquisition and regeneration never overwrite this user judgement.

nodes.label: /ref:verify (corrections overlay)
nodes.rationale: Accept/edit/reject decisions stored in corrections.json as a read-time overlay, never a rewrite of raw extraction; rejected claims drop out of ask/compare/graph.

nodes.label: /ref:describe-figure
nodes.rationale: Cached per (figure hash, model, prompt) and labelled model_interpretation, stored next to the caption never in place of it.

nodes.label: Name match never proves identity
nodes.rationale: A publication counts only once a specific author position is confirmed (identity_review_policy: confirmed_publications_only); rejected PMIDs are kept so they are never re-suggested.

nodes.label: Authorship role vs contribution flags
nodes.rationale: Role (sole/first/last/middle/unresolved) derived from position alone; shared_first/shared_senior/corresponding are separate reviewed flags needing evidence, never inferred from last position.

nodes.label: Funding observation kinds (indexed, explicit acknowledgement, possible_match)
nodes.norm_label: funding observation kinds (indexed, explicit acknowledgement, possible_match)

nodes.label: Frozen selector resolution
nodes.rationale: Selector resolved once and written into manifest.json; re-running with same --batch/--key reuses the frozen set and only --refresh re-resolves and reports added/removed, so a saved artifact never changes membership silently.

nodes.label: Single export path from meta.json (build_exports)
nodes.rationale: meta.json is the bibliographic authority and there is exactly one path to citation formats, so BibTeX and CSL-JSON cannot drift apart.

nodes.label: Extraction tiers (unavailable, abstract, full)
nodes.rationale: Tiers stay visible so every citation says whether abstract or full text backed it.

nodes.label: Ownership & recovery (files authoritative, projections rebuildable)
nodes.rationale: Files on disk are the authority; catalog.sqlite and okf/ are projections rebuilt by /ref:index --rebuild; user-owned content (notes.md, annotations, corrections) is never overwritten by regeneration.

nodes.label: Immutable content-addressed raw/<sha256>/ snapshots
nodes.rationale: Original PDF/JATS/metadata stored byte-identical under their hash; writes flow one way raw -> staging version -> atomic current.json swap.

nodes.label: Versioned derived records behind atomic current.json pointer
nodes.rationale: Staging directory then atomic swap so a crash mid-write never leaves a half-written version current; only committed versions reach the index.
nodes.norm_label: versioned derived records behind atomic current.json pointer

nodes.label: Papers.app handoff (asymmetric in/outbound)
nodes.rationale: Outbound is files only (Papers-dialect BibTeX + PDF copies), never writing the live database; outbound note push only on first export (D28); highlights have no outbound path as they are anchored to Papers' own file hash.

nodes.label: Prerequisites (Python>=3.11, PubMed MCP, pandoc, uv/trafilatura, anydoc, pdftotext)
nodes.rationale: Optional converters report 'unavailable' rather than substituting another tool; trafilatura runs under uv run to keep dependencies out of stdlib scripts.
nodes.norm_label: prerequisites (python>=3.11, pubmed mcp, pandoc, uv/trafilatura, anydoc, pdftotext)

nodes.label: Design commitments (PMID identity, empty start, raw immutable, user content, visible tiers, frozen sets)
nodes.norm_label: design commitments (pmid identity, empty start, raw immutable, user content, visible tiers, frozen sets)

nodes.label: Command map (seven command groups over one library)
nodes.norm_label: command map (seven command groups over one library)

nodes.label: Ingest & commit workflow (per-PMID lock, library lock for citekeys)
nodes.rationale: Per-PMID lock serializes writes to one paper; library-wide lock only while allocating a citekey; one paper's failure never blocks another.
nodes.norm_label: ingest & commit workflow (per-pmid lock, library lock for citekeys)

nodes.label: Full-text acquisition priority order
nodes.rationale: fetch.py stops at first applicable source; Unpaywall hit recorded as oa_location_found without downloading; PubMed full-text tool returns plain text so structure and figures are lost.

nodes.label: Teachme Mission: Maintaining the claude-ref-manager paper repo
nodes.norm_label: teachme mission: maintaining the claude-ref-manager paper repo

nodes.label: Lesson 0005: Weave and the Concept Graph
nodes.norm_label: lesson 0005: weave and the concept graph

nodes.label: Knowledge Layer v2 Figure (Claim v2 schema)
nodes.norm_label: knowledge layer v2 figure (claim v2 schema)

nodes.label: graphify-out lags renames (ref-weave.md -> weave.md)
nodes.rationale: graphify-out/ still indexed commands/ref-weave.md after the 2026-09-18 rename; fall back to find/grep if a graphify hit does not exist on disk.

nodes.label: Immutable content-addressed raw/<sha256>/
nodes.rationale: Re-fetching never overwrites; a new hash gets a new directory, so earlier source versions are never silently lost.

nodes.label: current.json atomic version pointer
nodes.rationale: Re-runs create a new versions/<v-id>/ and flip the pointer instead of mutating an old version in place.

nodes.label: corrections.json overlay via /ref:verify
nodes.rationale: Keeps every claim traceable to the extraction run that produced it while still allowing human correction; otherwise a manual fix is indistinguishable from model output.

nodes.label: Glance (status) vs diagnose (lint) split
nodes.rationale: status is a summary derived from the same counts lint gives in full; run status to decide whether lint is worth running.

nodes.label: Resume-safe repair state (maintenance/repair-fulltext-state.json)
nodes.rationale: Tracks attempts per PMID so re-runs make forward progress instead of re-hammering failures from the last 24h.

nodes.label: potentially_stale_artifacts (no silent overwrite of frozen artifacts)
nodes.rationale: When audit flips retraction status, dependent briefs/comparisons/summaries are flagged, not regenerated; refresh requires explicit --refresh.
nodes.norm_label: potentially_stale_artifacts (no silent overwrite of frozen artifacts)

nodes.label: Lint snapshots in maintenance/ enabling lint --diff
nodes.norm_label: lint snapshots in maintenance/ enabling lint --diff

nodes.label: Fetch source priority (PMC JATS > PubMed full text > Unpaywall > publisher HTML > abstract_only)
nodes.rationale: JATS is highest fidelity and the only path producing figures.json, so it is tried first; abstract_only is an expected outcome, not a failure.
nodes.norm_label: fetch source priority (pmc jats > pubmed full text > unpaywall > publisher html > abstract_only)

nodes.label: add/fetch separation (fetch never creates a paper record)
nodes.rationale: add is the explicit identity-resolution step (RESOLVE+DEDUP); folding it into fetch would let acquisition create records without resolution.
nodes.norm_label: add/fetch separation (fetch never creates a paper record)

nodes.label: Per-PMID independence (one failure never blocks the batch)
nodes.norm_label: per-pmid independence (one failure never blocks the batch)

nodes.label: Parallel ref-extractor fan-out per PMID
nodes.rationale: Study-type classification and PICO+ normalization need reading judgment, so extract is the one non-deterministic stage; per-paper independence isolates failures.

nodes.label: Literal "unknown" rule for undeterminable fields
nodes.rationale: A missing key looks like the extractor forgot to check; "unknown" makes the gap visible and machine-checkable.

nodes.label: evidence_span direct-quote requirement
nodes.rationale: Lets a human verify normalization against source text without re-reading the whole paper.

nodes.label: Retrieval invariant (status='active' AND excluded_from_synthesis=0)
nodes.rationale: status tracks supersession, excluded_from_synthesis tracks human rejection; independent axes, so neither alone says whether a claim is in play.

nodes.label: Three-case stable claim ID / supersession rule (assign_claim_ids)
nodes.rationale: Same hash keeps ID; no match with exactly one unconsumed prior at locator supersedes; zero or several priors asserts no supersession. Nothing is deleted.
nodes.norm_label: three-case stable claim id / supersession rule (assign_claim_ids)

nodes.label: Inline concept mapping (no dedicated weave subagent)
nodes.rationale: PLAN.md names only ref-extractor and ref-synthesizer; neither fits, so weave maps inline like /ref:check-citations.
nodes.norm_label: inline concept mapping (no dedicated weave subagent)

nodes.label: Find-before-create concept matching with aliases
nodes.rationale: concept.py matching is exact, case-insensitive, whitespace-normalized only; judgment about synonyms belongs to the calling agent, near-matches become aliases.

nodes.label: potential_conflict relation (only deterministic edge type)
nodes.rationale: relation.py propose can only detect opposite directions across different PMIDs; supports/extends/replicates need create-manual, and contradicts needs a rationale-required review.

nodes.label: MeSH terms resolve to concepts via aliases
nodes.norm_label: mesh terms resolve to concepts via aliases

nodes.label: Pure regeneration of okf/ and people_relations (--regenerate-only)
nodes.rationale: Never hand-edit derived views; edit JSONL sources and re-run /ref:weave --regenerate-only.
nodes.norm_label: pure regeneration of okf/ and people_relations (--regenerate-only)

nodes.label: people_relations.jsonl kept separate from relations.jsonl
nodes.rationale: The two schemas were designed independently and merging was not worth the risk.

nodes.label: Weave scope guardrail (selector-bounded, never library-wide)
nodes.rationale: Comparing every claim pair library-wide is expensive; only claims mapped to the same concept pair within selected papers are compared.

nodes.label: Ingest command selection by input type
nodes.rationale: Pick /ref:add, add-pdf, add-url, add-fetch or add-sources by input type; local files and URLs share one identify -> add -> attach/fetch shape.
nodes.norm_label: ingest command selection by input type

nodes.label: RoB 2 (five domains)
nodes.rationale: Three domains rateable from claim data; two always insufficient_information.

nodes.label: AMSTAR-2 (7 of 16 items)
nodes.rationale: Items matched by text patterns in evidence_span; stated shortcoming checked first.

nodes.label: Simplified GRADE certainty
nodes.rationale: Deliberately simpler than full GRADE: one level per factor, no upgrading, one rating per batch; baseline high only if all claims from RCTs.

nodes.label: Deterministic appraisal (no LLM)
nodes.rationale: Appraisal works only from committed claims so it can only rate what the claim schema records; abstract-tier papers refused, full text first.

nodes.label: Checklist chosen by majority claim study_type
nodes.norm_label: checklist chosen by majority claim study_type

nodes.label: PICO+ claim record
nodes.rationale: Every reported finding becomes its own structured record with PICO+ fields, provenance and identity/lifecycle fields.

nodes.label: Stable claim IDs across reruns
nodes.rationale: claim_registry.json keeps every claim ever committed; re-extraction compares against active claim at same locator.

nodes.label: Corrections as overlays, not edits
nodes.rationale: Extracted data is never edited in place; /ref:verify records accept/edit/reject overlays read together with the claim.

nodes.label: find_concept() before minting
nodes.rationale: Concept mapping done inline by /ref:weave; exact case/whitespace-insensitive match, never fuzzy; aliases cannot be taken from another concept (merge is user decision).

nodes.label: propose_relation() pure function
nodes.rationale: No LLM; only cross-PMID claim pairs; only proposes potential_conflict on opposite directions with identical comparator/measure/timepoint/population.

nodes.label: OKF v0.2 bundle (okf_emit.py)
nodes.rationale: Generated from JSONL/JSON sources: concepts/, papers/, people/, grants/, index.md, log.md.

nodes.label: Only extractor is an LLM step
nodes.rationale: Everything after the JSON-only extractor is validation, exact matching and deterministic comparison.
nodes.norm_label: only extractor is an llm step

nodes.label: Conflict review before contradicts
nodes.rationale: contradicts is refused without non-empty rationale; automatic check only proposes potential_conflict.

nodes.label: Manually earned edges (supports/extends/replicates)
nodes.rationale: Such edges come from reading papers, not PICO comparison.

nodes.label: /api/knowledge payload
nodes.rationale: Same payload served live or embedded in --static build, so both modes show identical views.

nodes.label: Maintenance loop (status/lint/index/audit/repair)
nodes.rationale: All maintenance state lives under the library root; maintenance/ exists purely for the loop.

nodes.label: Screening with a reason every time
nodes.norm_label: screening with a reason every time

nodes.label: Library view (papers table, coverage, action bar)
nodes.norm_label: library view (papers table, coverage, action bar)

nodes.label: Overview view (status, next actions, lint & changes)
nodes.norm_label: overview view (status, next actions, lint & changes)
